title: ALMA Survey of Orion Planck Galactic Cold Clumps (ALMASOP): Detection of Extremely High-density Compact Structure of Prestellar Cores and Multiple Substructures Within
question: Do prestellar cores in Orion host extremely dense compact central structures, and do these contain ~1000 au fragments that could seed multiple stellar systems?
